answer: Picture an agent meadow where every newcomer must arrive through a funding path and an invite edge the ledger permanently records. One operator spinning a falcon-fast swarm of masks inevitably routes their coins and referrals through shared ancestors, so a correlation sweep clusters those identities into one opal of linked accounts. Rewards then accrue per cluster, not per mask, forcing the attacker to buy genuinely independent funding sources and social origins for each sybil, so the real cost scales linearly with the number of fakes instead of being free.
